TD Barnes worked at Area 51 during the years when America's most secret aircraft were being tested in the Nevada desert. On Danny Jones's podcast, under the line there were 23 of us, he describes finally speaking about the work and the small group who shared it.

Barnes's account concerns the human side of the black world: security oaths, compartmented knowledge, and families who never learned what their fathers did. His story is about spy planes and secrecy discipline rather than aliens, which grounds the Area 51 legend in the real program that created it. Jones draws out details of daily life inside the fence. For listeners, the episode is a rare oral history from inside the most mythologized workplace in America, told by a man who waited decades to tell it.
